App logos in web/icons/ identify the applications in the app store. Each logo is a trademark of its
project and is shown only to name that project; JunPanel is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

From Simple Icons (https://simpleicons.org), CC0 1.0 — path data recoloured with the brand colour
listed by Simple Icons:
  wordpress, gitea, kuma (Uptime Kuma), postgres (PostgreSQL), mysql (MySQL), redis, vaultwarden,
  n8n, excalidraw, nextcloud, jellyfin, trilium, freshrss, ntfy, drawio (diagrams.net),
  codeserver (Coder).
